## Natural history notes

A nonnative armored catfish characterized by its brown body, bony plates along the sides, flattened underside, and long barbels around the mouth. In Florida, it is found in canals, ditches, ponds, marshes, and slow-moving freshwater habitats, especially in warm, vegetated waters. It feeds on bottom-dwelling invertebrates, detritus, and other organic material, and can tolerate low-oxygen conditions by gulping air at the surface.
